deploybot: Created tag release/v2.9.3 (v2.9.3) for commit abc1234ef. Targets: staging -> canary -> prod. Change window: 2026-03-21 00:00-00:30 UTC.
Changelog summary:
- Fix: tokenizer memory leak causing OOM on long sequences (PR #1123)
- Perf: improved kernel selection for Llama2 codepath (PR #1130)
- Docs: model pinning guide + example configs (PR #1140)
- Infra: healthcheck backoff tweak for autoscaling stability (PR #1145)
Rollout plan: canary 5% for 15m -> 25% for 10m -> 100% with 5m stabilization.
Pinning note: Dedicated pools that reference image tags should pin to `gcr.io/redwood/inference:v2.9.3-optim` to pick up the kernel perf fixes.
Links: changelog: https://repo.internal/release/2.9.3/changelog  |  diff: https://repo.internal/commit/abc1234ef
@here Eng-sre + Product: please verify customer-impacting notes and confirm pin guidance. Reaction: :rocket:
